precedence.base: Adopt the exact frozen C ABI normative bundle plus current e2 C implementation/564 header/660 pure calculation. Historical proposed/not-implemented status strings in precode bundles remain unchanged; they are not current execution claims.

precedence.private_exception: Only the separately specified bridge marker may override named unused private record bytes, in the new embedding profile. All other named reserved fields, inline unused tails, inactive unions, enum widths and public C ABI remain exact and zero as required.
precedence.diagnostic: This document deliberately admits no positive relation for the faithful true nested setter profile. That is an operational capture policy, not a rewrite/relaxation of model660.

selected_boundary.window: Begin before the first genuine source factory and all required cold origins/getters. Freeze only at the actual selected first-case Execute RETURN when closure succeeds; Seal/Retain/Copy/Drop remain lease controls. No GPU completion or readback is joined by this contract.
selected_boundary.first_factory: Select the first real internal DeviceCreate attempt before singleton/NEW/failed branch. A known singleton is not a new generation; unsupported first attempt never permits a later convenient NEW factory to replace it.
selected_boundary.first_draw: Select the first genuine candidate direct COM Draw before predication/noEmit/native pipeline branch. Unsupported/noEmit/GPL/descriptor_heap/cache/async/missing origin remains unknown or actual protocol refusal; do not pick a later writer or force the branch.
selected_boundary.epochs: Actual constructor Reset ordinal1, actual first-case Reset ordinal2; recording_epoch_ref is the actual Reset CallID from the sink. WarmReset3 is outside this one-epoch profile and cannot hydrate origins/getters or retag the old frame.
selected_boundary.cuts: Copy source logical history is frozen at each original COPY ENTRY, visible destination history at original Execute ENTRY. Only original successful defined RETURN creates a birth. No current lookup during Seal/Copy can rewrite facts.
selected_boundary.membership: Keep the exact previously declared finite family/variant membership including genuine nested same-vtable setters. Explicitly excluded originals remain forwarded, not claimed absent. ScopeGap is an observer diagnostic, never an API delegate or invented RETURN.

per_site_read_rules.rule: Compiled OFF calls originals directly with their actual arguments and return type, no new helper reference or borrowed field read. ON enters through the declared static membership/guard using only safe scalar addresses/source-owned identity bookkeeping; if unarmed/closed/unselected it does not evaluate typed descriptor/output/code observations. Scalar NULL comparisons are not readability proofs.

Require successful selected entry/may_project_before. Zero-init caller-owned PODs; copy actual operands by value once at the original ENTRY cut. Use each reviewed site expression and the normative field annex for lifetime, active union/version and exact widths. Required fixed original fields that cannot be safely observed must not be filled with0.

A typed API parameter or nonNULL address is not an observed ownership/readability witness. Every source site needs its exact legitimate valid-input borrow or internal allocated owner/read-lock lifetime; these are explicit preconditions of this prototype, not a universal invalid-pointer recovery guarantee. The future owned CPU controls provide real owned POD/arrays. Arbitrary game pointers and async/cache owners are not automatically admitted. No mprotect/probe/query/scan/exception-swallow mechanism may be invented to pretend readability.

Preserve actual original count and pointer separately from copied_count. Before any source-array access check original width, per-array cap, min(count,cap) multiplication and pointer+extent for U64/uintptr overflow. Arithmetic checks alone do not establish readable memory. Copy only a proven live safe prefix; count>cap/tail unavailable is incomplete, never relabeled full. Prefix must never exceed original count or schema cap.

Original nullable NULL observed uses observed=1/present=0, not unread observed=0. A nonnullable scalar whose observed value is numeric0 or pointer0 uses both bits1; zero is not missing. Missing required original nullable operand still causes NO_PAYLOAD; it cannot impersonate NULL. Genuine NULL CopyRanges sizes is preserved with unit-size semantics left to frozen model. Version/union-N/A follows the actual tag and never reads inactive storage. Count0 permits an unused NULL or nonNULL array pointer only where its original ABI defines it.

Original BOOL remains exact I32, including noncanonical nonzero values, not JSON Bool or a normalized1. Original D3D heapType is Enum32; Increment return is UINT32. Native/COM handles, internal object pointers and Vk handles keep separate domains. Floating API operands are captured as their exact U32 bit words via owned typed memcpy, never JSON floats or aliasing pointer casts. Derived complete/status flags are true U32 0/1 only.

Capture the real scalar/struct-return/void result in its true type first. Fresh return_admit must be OK+SELECTED+may_snapshot_defined_output before reading an output, and the original API must actually define that output for this exact return. Failed/pending output is unknown/absent, never observed0, caller-storage rewrite or fake success. A getter hidden output pointer must equal its true returned pointer where that ABI defines it; no fake pointer from the observer.

Detach required typed owner/identity operands BEFORE the original can free them; preserve Release ULONG vs Vulkan destroy void. After Release/Destroy do not reread the freed object, vtable, parent or rawU64. Source own RETURNevidence only closes COM at actual0; it is not GPU destruction or completion.

Metadata failures never suppress/retry/replace an original or hold its metadata lock through delegate/hash/cleanup. Existing pending token/counter/window behavior is retained faithfully. New private guards must specify whether they fail before a selected event/window or after an actual token has been admitted; no invented original ENTRY/RETURN, rollback or extra count. A refused fixed projection with a tracked token must still drain after the actual original returns.

At actual selected Execute RETURN retain immutable raw; later faults/leases/drain cannot rewrite it. No code, descriptor or object is re-read at Seal or ReceiptCopy. Any source guard operational state lives only in its expressly adopted private reserved span and does not become a wire fact or an alternate history registry.
